age.evidence: Plants of wild‐type Arabidopsis (Arabidopsis thaliana) ecotype Col‐0 were grown in phytotron under 120 μmol photons m−2 sec−1 (8 h light/16 h dark) using OSRAM PowerStar (Munich, Germany) HQIT 400/D Metal Halide lamps as the light source at 25°C for 32 days.
